title: Melatonin and Vitamins as Protectors against the Reproductive Toxicity of Bisphenols: Which Is the Most Effective? A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
authors: Pena-Corona, Sheila I; Chavez-Corona, Juan I; Perez-Caltzontzin, Luis E; Vargas-Estrada, Dinorah; Mendoza-Rodriguez, C Adriana; Ramos-Martinez, Edgar; Cerbon-Gutierrez, Jose L; Herrera-Barragan, Jose A; Quintanar-Guerrero, David; Leyva-Gomez, Gerardo
one_liner_zh: 系统综述和荟萃分析评估褪黑素和维生素对双酚类生殖毒性的保护作用，仅含少量分子对接（蛋白-配体），非蛋白质-DNA互作且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关系微弱。
abstract: Bisphenols such as bisphenol A (BPA), S (BPS), C (BPC), F (BPF), AF (BPAF), tetrabromobisphenol, nonylphenol, and octylphenol are plasticizers used worldwide to manufacture daily-use articles. Exposure to these compounds is related to many pathologies of public health importance, such as infertility. Using a protector compound against the reproductive toxicological effects of bisphenols is of scientific interest. Melatonin and vitamins have been tested, but the results are not conclusive. To this end, this systematic review and meta-analysis compared the response of reproductive variables to melatonin and vitamin administration as protectors against damage caused by bisphenols. We search for controlled studies of male rats exposed to bisphenols to induce alterations in reproduction, with at least one intervention group receiving melatonin or vitamins (B, C, or E). Also, molecular docking simulations were performed between the androgen (AR) and estrogen receptors (ER), melatonin, and vitamins. About 1234 records were initially found; finally, 13 studies were qualified for review and meta-analysis. Melatonin plus bisphenol improves sperm concentration and viability of sperm and increases testosterone serum levels compared with control groups; however, groups receiving vitamins plus bisphenols had lower sperm concentration, total testis weight, and testosterone serum levels than the control. In the docking analysis, vitamin E had the highest negative MolDock score, representing the best binding affinity with AR and ER, compared with other vitamins and melatonin in the docking. Our findings suggest that vitamins could act as an endocrine disruptor, and melatonin is most effective in protecting against the toxic effects of bisphenols.
abstract_zh: 双酚类化合物，如双酚A (BPA)、双酚S (BPS)、双酚C (BPC)、双酚F (BPF)、双酚AF (BPAF)、四溴双酚、壬基酚和辛基酚，是全球范围内用于制造日用品的增塑剂。接触这些化合物与许多具有公共卫生重要性的病理状况相关，例如不孕症。使用保护性化合物来对抗双酚类的生殖毒理学效应具有科学意义。褪黑素和维生素已被测试，但结果尚不明确。为此，本系统综述和荟萃分析比较了褪黑素和维生素给药作为对抗双酚类所致损伤的保护剂时，生殖变量的响应。我们检索了雄性大鼠暴露于双酚类以诱导生殖改变的对照研究，其中至少一个干预组接受褪黑素或维生素（B、C或E）治疗。此外，还进行了雄激素受体 (AR) 和雌激素受体 (ER) 与褪黑素及维生素之间的分子对接模拟。初步检索到约1234条记录；最终，13项研究符合综述和荟萃分析条件。与对照组相比，褪黑素加双酚类可提高精子浓度和精子活力，并增加血清睾酮水平；然而，接受维生素加双酚类的组别，其精子浓度、总睾丸重量和血清睾酮水平均低于对照组。在对接分析中，维生素E具有最高的负MolDock评分，代表其与AR和ER的结合亲和力最佳，优于其他维生素和褪黑素。我们的研究结果表明，维生素可能作为内分泌干扰物，而褪黑素在保护免受双酚类毒性效应方面最为有效。
